Name: Customer Add-On for Merchant
Author: DolphinIsNotaFish
Description:
[b][color=#dd7e6b][size=6]F[/size][size=5]eatures[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Haggling dialogue for all vanilla villagers.[/*]
[*]Marlon, Gunter, Gil and Morris as additional tourists if you didn't have mods that make the social. (automatically disabled if you do have those mods)[/*]
[*]Special tourism wave that randomly happens when it rains.[/*]
[/list][color=#b6d7a8][b]﻿[size=6]I[/size][size=5]nstallation[/size][/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][i]Content Patcher[/i][/url]﻿ and [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42801]Merchant[/url][/i]  installed.[/*]
[*]Download [b][i]Add-On for Merchant[/i][/b].[/*]
[*]Extract the downloaded file into the game's [font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[/list]To uninstall, simply delete [font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Add-On for Merchant[/font] from your Mods folder.

[color=#a2c4c9][b][size=6]C[/size][size=5]ompatibility[/size][/b][/color]
[list]
[*]No known compatibility issues. Please report if you find any![/*]
[/list][color=#9fc5e8][b][size=6]T[/size][size=5]ranslations[/size][/b][/color]
This mod uses i18n. If you want to make a translation for it, feel free to either give it to me (so I could incorporate it into the mod) or upload them yourself (do tell me so I can link to them!).
[spoiler]Built-in
[list]
[*]American English 1.1.0[/*]
[*]Japanese 1.1.0 (by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/OSHIKAWA?gameId=1303]OSHIKAWA[/url])[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[color=#b4a7d6][b][size=6]C[/size][size=5]redits[/size][/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Walking sprite for Gunther was an edited asset from  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5975][i]Seasonal Outfits for SVE[/i][/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url].[/*]
[*]Walking sprites for Marlon and Gil were edited assets from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7018][i]Make Marlon Real[/i][/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7118][i]Make Gil Real[/i][/url] respectively, by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/WerewolfMaster]WerewolfMaster[/url].[/*]
[*]Walking sprites for the Old Mariner is made for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31888][i]Dead Boy Detectives[/i][/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68019645]handwrittenhello[/url].[/*]
[/list][color=#d5a6bd][size=6][b]S[/b][/size][/color][size=5][color=#d5a6bd][b]pecial Thanks[/b][/color][/size]
To [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/mushymato?gameId=1303]mushymato[/url], for making the great [i]Merchant [/i]mod and lending me a save file with a fully decorated shop, so this mod's screenshotsI wouldn't expose my complete lack of interior-decorating.
